race.comment: Former Victorian KEEP IT REAL (3) is having his first run for the new stable but should find this easier than what he faced down south. Gets Rodd on top from a favourable draw and is sure to give backers a sight. RUMBLE TOWN (10) will strip fitter second-up from the break and gets some weight off from a low draw. Ticks a few boxes. DRACARIAN (12) scored a well-deserved win last start over 1125m at Toowoomba after a close third two runs back. Keep safe. GODTFRED KIRK (2) resumes from a short break for a new stable. Looks close to a win following a sound third over 1400m at Sale, beaten 1.4 lengths. In the mix.
